== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Crash Site Memorial]]. One column per published text state in date order: the printed card, Decipher's errata, and each Players Committee errata image (slip, disc card, E card, D-E1 card). The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Revised, Japanese, foil and Virtual printings stay in Versions. Yellow highlights mark words changed from the previous column. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Reflections Gold: [[Crash Site Memorial (Reflections Gold)]] is an unpublished playtest text of the cancelled [[Reflections Gold]] set (Decipher, 2001); it has its own column, labelled as such. Its highlights mark words that differ from the published column before it. The next published column is still compared with that published column, not with the playtest.
